notes_for_editor: Only the tnlandforms.us compiled list places this tower. Two WebSearches and the local caches found no Little Neck tower, no Chatham County lookout history and no removal notice. The Ron topo note is not explained on the page, and the story does not connect it to Ron Stafford, whom the page credits only in general terms. Do not conflate with Savannah Lookout Tower (GA049, Chatham, elevation 36, 32.04215,-81.18428), a separate entry in the same list. A Georgia Forestry Commission county contacts page (gatrees.org/gfc-contacts-2/county-contacts/) says Chatham has no local unit and is covered by the N. Bryan Unit; its date is unverified and it does not describe this tower, so it is left out of the story. The Red Bird Creek tower found in search is in Bryan County. The record's elevation_m (5.2) assumes the 17 is feet; the page gives no unit. Story is about 118 words, close to the guide's figure for thin sources; no other source describes the tower, so the editor may want to hold it. No photos.
